policy.language: English fields (nameEn, belligerents, conflict, countries, notesEn) contain Latin script only; an entity without an English label appears as its QID. Chinese fields (nameZh, belligerentsZh, conflictZh, countriesZh, notes) stay simplified. No transliteration or machine translation is used.
policy.coordinates: Points come from the Wikidata P625 statement of the battle entity; no coordinate is estimated or moved.
policy.participants: Belligerents come from P710 statements of the same entity; empty arrays mean the source does not state them and no value was invented.
policy.dates: Years come from the P585 statement; single-year precision is retained and no month or day is inferred. Wikidata stores ISO 8601 astronomical years, so BCE values are converted to the project civil-year convention, which has no year zero (ISO -489, i.e. 490 BCE, ships as -490). Where P585 contradicts the English and Chinese Wikipedia articles the record keeps the source value and states the conflict in its notes instead of silently changing it.
policy.names: Chinese names come from Wikidata zh labels; when an entity has no Chinese label but has a zh.wikipedia article, the article title is used and the record keeps labelSource=zhwiki-sitelink. An entity with no Chinese name in either place is not shipped.
policy.coverage: The thin-region supplements (editorial/battles-thin-regions-*.json, harvested by scripts/places/fetch-thin-region-battles.mjs in the 3.14 and 3.15 passes) sweep the Oceania, South Asia and Southeast Asia coordinate boxes and guarantee that every qualifying entity in those three regions ships, so a global quota cannot empty them. Entities whose Wikidata class is the massacre root, and three individually listed one-sided killings classed differently by Wikidata, are kept out of this layer and recorded in counts.supplementExcluded for a possible separate layer.
policy.outcome: The outcome field is intentionally absent: Wikidata has no stable, sourced property for battle results, and this project does not infer victors. It can be added later where a verifiable source states the result.
policy.provenance: Every entry links its Wikidata entity; statement-level reference URLs are included when Wikidata records them.
policy.region: Regions are assigned by a documented coordinate box rule (regionBasis=coordinate-box), not by political judgement.
